data.current_summary: Open the MCP server-to-client event stream
data.current_description: Opens the Streamable HTTP transport's SSE stream for server-initiated messages. FluoTest's server is stateless, so most clients never need it.
data.description_suggestion: Opens a Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream for receiving server-initiated messages from the MCP server. Requires the Mcp-Session-Id header and MCP-Protocol-Version header. Returns a continuous stream of JSON-RPC notifications. While FluoTest's server is stateless and most clients do not require this stream, it may be used for receiving asynchronous notifications or monitoring session state.
